name: Synthetic dairy farm, Delaware County, New York
about: The synthetic farm of the worked examples, in the input format of v0.3.8. Every laboratory value is invented and labelled as such; it is copied unchanged from the PFAS example (examples/FARM-PFAS-SIMULATION-2026-10-31-r7.en.md, sections 3–4) and equals tests/fixtures/sim1_pfas.json (checked by a test). Sampling dates, methods and laboratories are written exactly as the example gives them: where the example names none, the cell says 'not stated' or 'synthetic'. No real coordinates.

consent.note: synthetic farm — there is no farm to consent; a real farm needs its written consent (indicator X-07) before anything is computed

objects.label: Biosolids — class B, small municipal plants
Field F1 — 10 seasons of biosolids, 0–20 cm
Field F5 — control, no biosolids, 0–20 cm
Well, 35 m, farmstead — people and herd
